name: PREDICTION: European Auto Industry Cascade — German Manufacturing Crisis

trigger.description: VW 35,000 job cuts + Continental/ZF restructuring + 21.4% US export decline cascade into Central/Eastern European supplier economies and Turkish auto parts sector

reasoning: German OEMs (VW, BMW, Mercedes) are the anchor employers for entire supply chain ecosystems in Central/Eastern Europe and Turkey. VW alone employs 120,000 in Germany and sustains 300,000+ supplier jobs across EU. The 35,000 job cut announcement is the trigger, but CascadeAI predicts the second-order effects: Czech/Slovak/Hungarian factories that supply VW face order cancellations within 90 days. Turkey's auto parts sector (5% of GDP, $35B exports) loses its second-largest customer. These are countries with limited social safety nets compared to Germany.

predictions.prediction: Turkish auto parts exports decline 15-25% by Q4 2026 as German OEM orders collapse; $5-8B revenue loss
predictions.mechanism: German OEM restructuring -> order cancellation to Turkish Tier-2 suppliers -> export revenue loss
predictions.data_source_to_verify: Turkish Statistical Institute (TUIK); OSD (Automotive Manufacturers Association); Turkish export data
predictions.confidence: HIGH — Turkey's auto sector exports 75% to EU; Germany is largest customer

predictions.prediction: 50,000-80,000 auto sector job losses in Bursa/Kocaeli industrial zones by Q1 2027
predictions.mechanism: ECONOMY(export decline) -> JOBS(factory closures/layoffs in auto corridor)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: Turkish Employment Agency (ISKUR); Bursa Chamber of Industry; ILO Turkey
predictions.confidence: HIGH — auto sector employs 500,000+ directly; 15-25% revenue loss maps to proportional job impact

predictions.prediction: Internal migration from Bursa/Kocaeli to Istanbul increases 10-15%; adds pressure to already-strained 4M+ Syrian refugee hosting infrastructure
predictions.mechanism: JOBS(auto layoffs) -> DISPLACEMENT(economic migration) compounds with existing refugee hosting burden
predictions.data_source_to_verify: TUIK internal migration data; UNHCR Turkey; Istanbul municipality reports
predictions.confidence: MEDIUM — migration pattern is established; scale depends on social safety net response

predictions.prediction: Pakistani auto parts exports to EU decline 20-30%, affecting 200,000+ workers in Lahore/Karachi industrial estates
predictions.mechanism: European OEM order cuts cascade to low-cost suppliers; Pakistan's $2B auto parts export sector loses orders
predictions.data_source_to_verify: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics; PAMA (Pakistan Automotive Manufacturers); SBP trade data
predictions.confidence: MEDIUM — Pakistan is a growing but smaller supplier; impact proportional to EU dependency

predictions.prediction: Indian auto component sector benefits from trade diversion — Bharat Forge, Motherson gain $2-4B in redirected orders by Q2 2027 as OEMs shift from China/EU to India (18% tariff deal)
predictions.mechanism: US-India 18% tariff deal (Feb 2026) makes India competitive vs 25% EU tariff; order redirection
predictions.data_source_to_verify: ACMA (Auto Component Manufacturers Association); Bharat Forge/Motherson quarterly results
predictions.confidence: HIGH — tariff arbitrage is clear; Indian suppliers already reporting increased inquiry volumes

key_insight: CascadeAI shows that a German factory closure doesn't just affect German workers — it cascades into Turkish auto workers in Bursa, Pakistani welders in Lahore, and compounds refugee pressure in Istanbul. The delay is 6-12 months, creating a window for preventive action.
